learning_outcomes.text: Provide basic concepts and knowledge related to materials science. For this, the structure and properties of materials in a broad sense are addressed.

syllabus_topics: Atomic cohesion, elasticity, material families, atomic architecture and defects
Macroscopic and microscopic plasticity in metals; hardening by: work hardening, grain size, solid solution and precipitation
Phase diagrams, with total solubility (Cu-Ni) or partial solubilities (Pb-Sn), Fe-C diagram (steels and cast irons)
Fracture and toughness of ceramic and metallic materials. Application to the case of fatigue of metallic materials
Influence of time on materials. Application to viscoelastic polymers
Influence of orientation on materials: Application to anisotropic composite materials
bibliography: JP Baïlon et JM Dorlot: Des Matériaux, PIP, troisième édition.
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
